title: Download the Completed Project Code
section: 20. Boss Level Challenge 2 - The Simon Game
summary: Wrap-up page for the Simon Game challenge: a link to a live hosted version of the finished game and a pointer to the complete solution in Course Resources.

concepts.heading: Key takeaways
points: A hosted copy of the finished game is at https://londonappbrewery.github.io/Simon-Game/ (a GitHub Pages site); use it to compare behaviour, timing and sounds with your own build.

The full completed project (index.html, styles.css, game.js and the sounds folder) is downloadable from the blue Course Resources button in the top-left corner of the lecture screen, with every challenge step marked in the code.
The project exercises the JavaScript and jQuery sections together: arrays, functions, conditionals, event listeners, setTimeout, jQuery selectors, class toggling, animations and the Audio object.
The complete reconstructed game.js and a list of differences in the reference repo are in the Step 10 Answer notes (lecture 182).

code_examples.caption: Finished project layout
code_examples.code:
Simon Game/
  index.html   (h1#level-title + 2x2 grid of .btn divs; loads jQuery, then game.js)
  styles.css   (button colours, .pressed, .game-over, Press Start 2P font)
  game.js      (all game logic)
  sounds/      (red.mp3, blue.mp3, green.mp3, yellow.mp3, wrong.mp3)

pitfalls: (Extra) Opening the downloaded index.html from a zipped folder can stop the sound files loading; extract the archive first.
